notes: Scope: 4 business data flows (FT, Create fundmain for transferin, Create transferin Maslulim, Create Acount Courses and course partition for transferin). 32 CRM write components in the package: 27 business writers mapped here (20 SDK scripts in 4 groups of 5 identical copies + 7 OLE DB commands). Excluded as ETL plumbing: End ETL Process record\ETL Record Finish (SDK) and the 4 'insert etl process warning*' SQL inserts; their open ErrorMessage / gen_etlprocessid script outputs were intentionally not resolved.

FINDING 1 (gen_transferin.gen_transferid): SDK Create gen_TransferIn writes transferIn["gen_transferid"] = Row.genbankaccountnumber (main.cs:61-62) — the zero-padded SOURCE ACCOUNT NUMBER (Source_Fund_AccountNumber_20), not a transfer id. The staged bank-transaction id (PY_FileData.BankTransaction_ID_91, read as gen_transferid) is not an input of 'Sort' and never reaches the writer.

FINDING 2 (data-flow failure on blank dates): the 'Format Dates' scripts of Create transferin Maslulim (DTSX 41626, main.cs:55-58) and Create Acount Courses and course partition (DTSX 4854, main.cs:55-58) do `if (String.IsNullOrEmpty(str)) str = null; switch (str.Trim().Length)` → NullReferenceException (no try/catch) when Action_Expected_Date_54 is blank (Trim turns an all-space field into ""). One such row reaching Format Dates fails the whole data flow (no gen_transferin, or no gen_accountcourses / gen_coursepartition). The FT copy of Format Dates (DTSX 60676) returns null early and is safe.

FINDING 3 (Update Dmei Slika Month Salary is independent of the insert): it hangs off Multicast 3 Output 3 (after Get fund main id), so gen_demislikamonthsalary is marked as identified (date = GETDATE(), flag = 1, ModifiedBy = CrmAdminId) even when the Gen_ftCurrentYearBase insert of the same row fails (error output) — and once per qualifying file row. ModifiedOn is set with GETDATE() (server local time) while CRM stores UTC.

FINDING 4 (error wiring): 'Create gen_fundmain 3' Error output is connected to 'Union All Created' (success counter, Input 4) instead of 'Union All Error' — failures of that copy are counted as created and never written as ETL warnings (path list, survey line 'Create gen_fundmain 3.Outputs[Error] => Union All Created').

FT: rows whose own-side account + product has no gen_fundmain ('Get fund main id' No Match output not connected) and rows with Action_Transfer_Direction_69 not in {1,2} ('אחר' output not connected) are dropped silently (no warning). Rows without a matching gen_fundtransactiontype ARE inserted (gen_transactiontypename NULL) and also logged as warning. Rows whose finance id has no Product go to warnings only.

FT Gen_ftCurrentYearBase INSERT (Unsupported): system columns (OwnerId, CreatedBy/On, ModifiedBy/On, OwningBusinessUnit, statecode 0, statuscode 1, TransactionCurrencyId, ExchangeRate 1) are set by hand; the primary key is Guid.NewGuid() in SSIS; no OwnerIdType column — bypasses CRM plugins/workflows/audit. 'Check if trans exists' is full cache, so duplicates inside the same file are not detected.

FT column naming traps (positional binding proven): column gen_fundtypenumber receives gen_fundTypeName = Product.ProductId (GUID); column gen_bankname receives gen_banksid (bank '10' looked up by a constant); gen_bankbranchname / gen_accounttypename / gen_accountnumber / gen_bank always come from the SOURCE checking account even for direction 2, while gen_currentaccount* swap by direction; gen_leadfinanceid always uses Target_Fund_FundType_43.

FT amounts: 'Format money fields' casts trimmed strings with (DT_CY) (errorRowDisposition FailComponent); only NULL is handled, so a blank amount field ("") fails the FT data flow. Salary/tax amounts in the scripts use decimal.TryParse (unparsable → 0) and /100.

FT dates are written as UTC strings "yyyy/MM/dd HH:mm:ss" (Format Dates + Dates ToUniveral); a 6-char value YYYYMM (Monthly_Deposit_79) becomes the 1st of the month. gen_salarydate and gen_salarymonthid receive the same value; gen_actualexecutiondate equals gen_entrydate; gen_refunddate equals gen_paymentdate; gen_requestsum equals gen_taxdeductedfromaccount equals gen_transtotalamount.

insert ftCurrentYearBase 4 is not listed in dupes.json only because the XML order of its input columns 76-78 differs; SQL text is identical (verified byte-equal) and every input binds to the same Param_k, so its mapping is identical to copy 1 (mapped as a separate entry).

Create fundmain for transferin: creates a fund for the SOURCE account number in the DESTINATION course. Only gen_bankaccountnumber (Source_Fund_AccountNumber_20), gen_fundtypenumber (Target_Fund_course_44) and gen_fundnumber (both) carry file values; gen_fundtypename is the destination product looked up by Target_Fund_course_44; all other attributes are copied from the source fund (CRM) or are literals (14 Money fields = 0, gen_weightedmanagementfeepercentage 0.0, gen_inputsource 1, gen_existinfile true, address texts from 'Set Fields'). gen_fundcreationdate = getutcdate() of the lookup cache load (+ToLocalTime), not the source fund's date.

Filter differences between flows: Create fundmain requires Transfer_Type_2 == "1"; Create transferin Maslulim requires Transfer_Type_2 == "2" and Action_Operation_Type_57 != "04"; Create Acount Courses has no Action/Transfer type filter at all — it creates gen_accountcourses / gen_coursepartition for every non-last PY row whose Request_ID_74 + Target_Fund_AccountNumber_47 match an existing gen_transferin (including transfer-ins from earlier runs), de-duplicated only against CRM ('Check for exist account courses' no cache; 'Check if exist course partition' full cache), so duplicate rows in the same file can create duplicates.

Create transferin Maslulim: left Sort de-duplicates on (request, account, fund type, delivery date) but the Merge Join uses only the first 3 keys, so two file rows of the same request with different Action_Expected_Date_54 both join → two gen_transferin creates are possible ('get tranferin' is full cache and does not see same-run creates). gen_accountnumbersrc and gen_customeraccountdest are set to the same customer account. 'Handle Gemel To Invest Case' maps fund type 5006 → 1025 before Trim and calls .Equals without NULL check.

Create Acount Courses 'get dest fund' SQL (DTSX 5637) has a missing comma: `c.Gen_Identitynumber gen_fundtypename` aliases the contact identity number as gen_fundtypename (output gen_fundtypename_D). Not written to CRM. The lookup also INNER JOINs Contact and Gen_agentcontract, so destination funds without contact or broker contract never get a gen_coursepartition. 'set additional fields' casts (DT_I4)Action_Operation_Type_57 with FailComponent: a blank/non-numeric value fails the flow. Its 'Dates ToUniveral' reads CrmMinimumDate only in PostExecute, so the min-date exemption never applies.

Unused writer inputs (not written): Create Acount Courses gen_fundtypename_S, gen_transfertype (accountcourses) and gen_fundtypename_D, gen_fundtypenumber_D, gen_transfertype (coursepartition). Create gen_fundmain input gen_address1_city is readWrite but only read.
